messages:
maria: quick callout  found another inconsistency in the Dedicated provisioning docs. the SDK examples still show one `labels` map in a few places and that caused a support case where tenant intent was silently dropped. can we standardize on `tenant_labels` + `binding_labels` and document precedence?

samir: yep. short: binding_labels are authoritative at allocation time; tenant_labels are merged for policy checks after allocation. we added explicit params last quarter but the handbook wasn't updated everywhere.

elaine: thanks. i can do a focused doc pass. plan: add a 'label precedence' subsection, update python + go examples, and add a one-line note in autoscale that links to it. we should also include a tiny 3-row decision cheat (mobile-friendly).

kevin: sample go snippet to use in PR: ```go
client.CreateReservedCapacity(ctx, CreateReservedCapacityParams{
  TenantID: "acct-777",
  TenantLabels: map[string]string{"env":"staging","team":"vision"},
  BindingLabels: map[string]string{"reserved_tier":"silver","env":"staging"},
  ReservedPool: "gpu-pool-edge",
})
```

samir: add a short YAML illustrating how fallback interacts with preemption (customers lose KV if they don't preserve it): ```yaml
routing:
  - when: pool_preempted
    to: model:opt-6b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: false
  - when: pool_saturated
    to: model:llama-7b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: true
```

maria: also, the internal handbook anchor moved during the TOC refactor so some autoscale pages 404 to the isolation section. please fix anchors and add a tiny test that renders the doc and asserts the anchor exists.

elaine: will do. i'll open the PR and add a pytest render test that greps for the anchor id. i'll keep the table compact: 3 rows (tenant-only -> no preemption; binding+tenant -> binding wins; conflicting reserved_tier -> explicit policy required).

kevin: ping infra: @dev-docs-bot can you run link-check once branch is up? :mag:

dev-docs-bot: link-check queued for branch/patch/provisioning-labels-279501. report will be posted in this thread.

sdk-bot: quick check: public SDK reference currently missing `binding_labels` on Go page. i created internal ticket SDK-2045 to sync after docs PR merges.

elaine: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4379  includes updated python+go snippets, label precedence subsection, small decision table, YAML fallback example, anchor fix, and render test. PTAL.

kevin: reviewed, left two micro-nits on phrasing and one suggested example tweak. approved after edits.

maria: merged. deployed to staging, verified anchor and examples render.

dev-docs-bot: link-check complete  1 fixed anchor, 0 remaining broken links. full report: https://ci.internal/reports/279501-linkcheck (internal)

samir: i'll follow up with SDK owners and support with a short note and sample combos. logging KB update (KB-11005) for customer-facing guidance.

maria: thanks everyone. adding a line to the release notes about the sample API shape change and the decision cheat. archiving after release notes publish. :thumbsup:
